cases.title: Oil Painting
cases.prompt:
A richly worked oil painting fills the entire square image, showing a small Mediterranean harbor from a low stone quay in warm late-afternoon light. One weathered blue-and-white wooden sailboat sits slightly right of center in the foreground, its mast and fine rigging crossing the pale sky. Coils of rope, chipped paint along the gunwale, a folded ochre sail and a brass cleat are distinct. Behind it, a dense crescent of pastel waterfront houses climbs a hillside: terracotta roofs, narrow shutters, striped fabric awnings, balconies with flower pots, carved stone doorways and small staircases form a coherent inhabited town. Two small moored fishing boats rest farther away beside the quay. Olive trees and dark cypress foliage break up the architecture without hiding the building fronts. The deep blue water reflects the houses in fragmented turquoise, coral and gold strokes.

The image is unmistakably a physical oil painting viewed straight on, not a photograph or a smooth digital render. Confident thick impasto on sunlit walls and water highlights alternates with thin translucent paint in the shadows. Palette-knife ridges, overlapping brush hairs, small flecks of pigment and visible linen canvas weave create intricate tactile surface detail. Individual brush marks remain visible at every scale; fine rigging and window edges are painted with controlled thin strokes. The foreground boat and nearby reflections are sharply articulated, while the hillside becomes softly atmospheric. The painted composition reaches all four edges, with no outer frame, photographed studio, captions, signature or watermark.

cases.title: Sketch
cases.prompt:
A highly detailed graphite-and-ink drawing of a classic unbranded twin-lens reflex camera fills a square sheet of softly textured ivory paper. The main camera is drawn large in a precise front-right three-quarter view, centered on the page. Its tall rectangular body has black pebbled leather panels with individually drawn grain, brushed metal edge rails, recessed screw heads with clear slots, a large knurled side focusing knob, a smaller film-advance crank and two strap lugs. Exactly two glass lenses are vertically aligned on the front board: an upper viewing lens and a lower taking lens. The two concentric lens barrels have fine radial grooves, thin adjustment rings, tiny engraved tick marks and restrained window reflections. The open waist-level finder rises from the top of the body as four thin folded hood panels around a small horizontal focusing screen. The front panel, side controls and top hood are physically connected.

The composition is an artist's finished object study, not a labeled engineering diagram. Every shadow is built from varied pencil pressure, close parallel hatching, fine cross-hatching and stippling. Faint construction arcs and erased perspective lines remain visible beside the finished contours. Draw the metal and glass with fine smooth strokes and the leather with small irregular interlocking marks. Two small unlabeled studies occupy the lower corners: a straightforward front elevation with the same two stacked lenses at lower left, and a circular magnified study of a ridged metal knob at lower right. The main drawing remains much larger than these studies. The only lettering anywhere on the page is the hand-lettered heading "TWIN-LENS REFLEX" at the top and the small subtitle "A STUDY IN LIGHT & LINE" beneath it. There are no part labels, leader lines, arrows, brand names, written measurements, stray annotations, watermarks or surrounding desktop. Fine paper fibers, dense hatching, leather grain, screw slots and closely spaced lens-ring ticks provide rich detail on close inspection.

cases.title: Botany
cases.prompt:
A finished, information-rich educational poster fills a square canvas. It combines refined botanical watercolor and precise pen illustration with highly readable editorial typography on warm ivory paper. Its large dark green title is exactly "BOTANY BASICS". Directly beneath it is the subtitle "Plant Structure & Photosynthesis". Forest green, muted sage, soft ochre and restrained terracotta form a coherent palette. A fine grid, thin rules and generous internal spacing keep the abundant information organized. The poster is viewed straight on, with no frame or surrounding room.

The middle half of the poster has three columns. The broad center column contains a large, anatomically plausible illustration of one flowering herbaceous plant, extending from branching exposed roots below a fine soil line to the upper leaves, buds and flowers. The stem, root hairs, narrow side shoots, leaf veins and delicate flower structures are exquisitely drawn. This central plant has NO labels or leader lines. A small separate detailed leaf study sits near its lower right without overlapping it. A quiet caption directly beneath this central illustration reads "ONE PLANT, CONNECTED SYSTEMS".

The left column is a neatly typeset text panel titled "01 / PLANT STRUCTURE". It contains four clearly separated entries in this exact order, with the bold heading and the explanatory copy directly underneath each heading: "ROOTS" followed by "Absorb water and minerals. Anchor the plant."; "STEMS" followed by "Support leaves and flowers. Transport water and sugars."; "LEAVES" followed by "Capture light. Exchange gases with the air."; "FLOWERS" followed by "Support reproduction. Help form fruits and seeds.". These four entries contain text only, with no icons, small pictures or arrows. Below them, a delicate standalone watercolor flower fills the remaining space, with the simple caption "FLOWER STUDY" and no part labels.

The right column is titled "02 / A CLOSER LOOK". Its upper panel shows a finely drawn cutaway section through a leaf, with a thin top surface, tightly arranged elongated green cells beneath it, a lower layer of irregular cells and visible air spaces, and a protective lower surface. The illustration contains NO text or pointing lines. Its caption, placed BELOW the picture in a separate text block, is "INSIDE A LEAF", followed by "Layers of living cells capture light and allow gases to move.". The lower panel shows a magnified oval chloroplast with a double boundary and several connected stacks of small green discs. Its illustration also has NO labels or pointing lines. Below it, a separate caption reads "CHLOROPLAST", followed by "Chlorophyll captures light. Photosynthesis stores energy in sugars.". Fine cell boundaries and repeated disc edges make the illustrations rich in detail.

A wide bottom section is titled "03 / PHOTOSYNTHESIS". It contains exactly three clearly separated boxes arranged LEFT TO RIGHT. The left box is headed "INPUTS" and contains two lines: "Carbon dioxide / CO2" and "Water / H2O". The center box is headed "LIGHT ENERGY" and contains a small sun-and-leaf illustration with the caption "Captured by chlorophyll". The right box is headed "OUTPUTS" and contains two lines: "Glucose / C6H12O6" and "Oxygen / O2". A single thin arrow points RIGHT from the left box into the center box, and a second thin arrow points RIGHT from the center box into the right box. These two arrows are the only arrows anywhere in the poster. Under the boxes, the balanced equation occupies its own uncluttered centered line and reads exactly "6 CO2 + 6 H2O + light → C6H12O6 + 6 O2". A narrow footer reads "Roots collect. Stems transport. Leaves transform.". Preserve all supplied wording, the title, box ordering and equation. Maintain crisp small type, careful spacing, fine botanical detail and consistent typography. Do not add labels onto drawings, duplicate copy, extra arrows, unexplained symbols, branding, decorative illegible writing or QR codes.

cases.detail_hint: Fine leaf veins, repeated cell structures and small type.

cases.title: Food

In the center, a large woven basket holds a freshly baked rustic loaf of bread with a cracked golden-brown crust and scattered flour, alongside a halved loaf. To the left, a large dark ceramic plate presents an assortment of colorful seasonal vegetables, including bright orange carrots, deep red heirloom tomatoes, purple cabbage, and a mound of vibrant green leafy kale and arugula. On the right side, a wooden board displays artisanal cheeses: a wedge of sharp aged cheddar, a round of creamy brie with a rind, a soft blue cheese, and a few scattered almonds and walnuts. Below the bread in the lower center, a shallow bowl contains roasted root vegetables, including golden potatoes and beets, sprinkled with fresh rosemary sprigs. At the upper right, a glass jar of golden olive oil stands beside a smaller jar of honey with a wooden dipper. In the lower left, a rustic cloth napkin holds a silver knife and fork. At the upper left, a bunch of purple and red grapes rests near a small bowl of black olives. Scattered herbs, including fresh thyme and sprigs of oregano, decorate the table. The lighting is natural and warm, coming from the upper left and casting soft, long shadows to the lower right, enhancing the texture of the bread, the moisture of the vegetables, and the overall cozy, bountiful atmosphere of the meal.

cases.title: Game World
cases.prompt:
A single full-frame landscape gameplay-style visual concept for an original third-person exploration game, rendered as detailed real-time 3D game art. The camera is behind and slightly above one adult explorer in the lower-left foreground. The explorer wears a short ochre rain cape, dark trousers and a compact canvas backpack, with both boots planted on a wet stone landing. Their head and body face the distant destination at screen right; one small brass lantern hangs from their right hand. The character occupies about one-fifth of the image height so the environment and route remain easy to read.

A continuous narrow stone bridge begins at the foreground landing, bends through the center of the frame and ends at an open arched doorway on the right side of a ruined observatory. The entire bridge remains visible above calm floodwater, with plausible supports, shallow steps and a low parapet along its outer edge. Warm amber light inside the destination doorway contrasts with cool blue twilight outside. Broken telescope housings, oxidized copper domes and moss-covered masonry make the observatory distinctive. Reeds and floating leaves sit below the bridge, while distant mountains recede into low mist. Water reflects the architecture and doorway light in the correct places. Natural material detail, atmospheric depth and restrained bloom support a believable game environment. The frame contains exactly one human character, no enemies, no HUD, no written text, no logos and no outer monitor or device border.
cases.configuration: SP4 · MXFP8 DiT · resident weights · six steps · seed 42
cases.detail_hint: Weathered masonry, metalwork, foliage and water reflections.

presentation: Each scene compares browser-resized versions of one measured 4K image. Left and right output tiers are independent. Aspect ratios are preserved; actual dimensions are labeled. Separate archived generation sizes remain linked, without inventing missing measurements.
source_outputs: Archived API outputs are linked per scene with their measured dimensions and timings. The 1K API output uses a 2K generation canvas before resizing. Missing generated sizes are not inferred from browser resizes.
